name: Yingxia 映匣
subtitle: Free, native TVBox player
description:
免费的原生 TVBox 播放器：直播频道、点播片库，以及一次搜索所有片源。

Free, native TVBox player for iPhone and iPad. Live channels, on-demand catalogs and one search across all your sources.

versions.localizedDescription:
• 推荐源由你选择
• 搜索进度列表恢复显示
• 长文件名选集更清楚
• 连续播放更稳定
• 其他修复

• Recommended sources are your choice
• Search progress is visible again
• Tell video files apart
• Smoother playback between episodes
• Other fixes

• 搜索只显示匹配的结果
• 离线缓存可以连续播放
• 在视频页任意位置右滑返回
• 来电或闹钟结束后音乐继续播放
• 其他修复

• Search shows what you searched for
• Offline Cache plays on
• Swipe back from anywhere on a video page
• Music plays again after a call or an alarm
• Other fixes

• 用插件添加直播平台
• 登录红果短剧
• 空白页和出错页焕然一新
• 所选字幕延续到下一集
• 其他修复

• Add live platforms as plugins
• Sign in to Hongguo
• A cleaner look for empty and error pages
• Your subtitle choice carries to the next episode
• Other fixes

• iPhone 全屏后点击恢复正常
• 虎牙弹幕不再中断
• 猫源不再导致 App 退出
• 其他修复

• Full screen on iPhone answers taps again
• Huya danmaku keeps flowing
• CatPawOpen sources no longer close the app
• Other fixes

• 云盘播放自动适配设备
• 字幕：ASS 样式与图片字幕
• 播放与播放器控制
• 搜索、评分与片源
• Mac：视频页与漫画页
• 其他修复

• Cloud drives that adapt to your device
• Subtitles: ASS styling and picture subtitles
• Playback and player controls
• Search, ratings and sources
• Mac: video and comic pages
• Other fixes
